message.content: {"rationale": "Bg5 is the only commit-ready move: single-candidate verification at effective depth 4 returned exact score 69 with no mate-in-one and no tactical refutation found. It develops the dark-squared bishop actively to g5, attacking d8 queen and f6, and does not return a piece home. Other candidates had only upper-bound scores from a shallower search, which are not comparable. Black can answer Qxg5 but that is not a refutation; the engine line f8e7/Bxe3 keeps a small edge. No concrete evidence justifies a different move.", "objective": "Develop the dark-squared bishop to g5, targeting d8/f6, and complete castling next.", "move": "c1g5", "action": "commit"}
